reconcile.title: Payment reconciliation
reconcile.description: A donation may remain “pending” if the donor closed the page before confirmation. Reconciliation re-reads its status with the provider (Stripe for cards, Notch Pay or Flutterwave for Mobile Money), confirms those that went through (the receipt is then sent automatically), recovers late-confirmed payments, flags for review those whose amount does not match, and closes those abandoned for more than 24 hours.
reconcile.confirmText: Donations pending for more than 15 minutes, as well as failed or cancelled donations from the last 7 days, will be checked with the providers. Those still unanswered after 24 hours will be closed as abandoned.
reconcile.noProviderText: No payment provider is connected to the server yet: only abandoned payments will be closed.
